name: Olympian Laurel Hoplon Guard
loreTies: A city-state guardian of the Celestial Heights, trained to treat foreign Titans as trial defendants before the marble sky courts.
Creates defensive walls and protects ranged allies.
source culture humans later copied as Greek myth
shortBackstory: Olympian Laurel Hoplon Guard is a lore-faithful Olympian run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Olympian Laurel Hoplon Guard belongs to The Celestial Heights of Olympus and exists to express Olympian law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Creates defensive walls and protects ranged allies.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Bronze-white hoplon armor, laurel flame crest, marble-cloud greaves, star-polished spear. Abilities — Phalanx Pin, Laurel Guard, Trial Rebuke — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Titan-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
